definition: to keep something as it is, unharmed
description: A sandy beach at sunset. A detailed sandcastle with towers and a little flag stands at the edge of the sea, covered by a big clear glass dome. A wave crashes against the dome and sprays white foam, then washes around it, but the sandcastle inside stays dry and whole. A laughing young woman in a white shirt kneels in the surf holding the dome, a young man in blue shorts kneels on the other side holding it too, and a woman in a yellow top and denim shorts throws her arms up and cheers behind them.
